No infinite binary absence is asserted. Both included programs compiled/executed or ran successfully from staged file paths and exact certificates were reexamined.

value.rationale: The motivating 2026 primary article explicitly conjectures this class of all-intermediate-value feasibility; its lifting theorem depends on finite seeds at each numerical level. A full exact positive feasibility spectrum for every q≥3 answers that natural structural existence question, with a short exceptional ternary 18 witness and a sharp finite binary non-realization range, rather than a disconnected arbitrary numerical calculation.
